author: Jacqui Dalgleish
content:
Thank you, thank you, thank you. USB provided me with a helter skelter, shooting range and ‘beat the buzzer’ during my 60th birthday celebrations at Bannockburn House. What can I say, it went down an absolute treat and will be spoken about for a long time to come.
Kaleigh, you were friendly, helpful and informative from the onset and dealt with all my requests efficiently. Your team who delivered and removed the items on the day were polite and a pleasure to deal with. Overall, USB are a fantastic team who are friendly and professional. Will certainly be back in touch when the occasion arises. Thank you again for helping my 60th party a memorable one.
